Les opérations, les priorités de calcul,: Operations, order of operations, fractions and prime numbers.
Priorités : parenthèses, puissances, pui: Order of operations: parentheses, powers, then multiplication and division (left to right), then addition and subtraction.
Pour additionner des fractions, on les m: To add fractions, put them over a common denominator: 3/4 + 1/8 = 6/8 + 1/8 = 7/8. You never add the denominators.
Diviser par une fraction, c'est multipli: Dividing by a fraction means multiplying by its reciprocal: 2 ÷ 1/2 = 4.
Un nombre premier a exactement deux divi: A prime number has exactly two divisors, 1 and itself. So 1 is not prime; 2 is the only even prime.
6 ÷ 2 × 3 vaut 9, pas 1 : à priorité éga: 6 ÷ 2 × 3 equals 9, not 1: with equal priority, the convention is to work from left to right.
Une barre coupée en 4 dont 3 parts color: A bar cut into 4 with 3 parts colored, a bar cut into 8 with 1 part colored
Règle de trois, échelles, hausses et bai: Rule of three, scales, percentage increases and decreases.
La règle de trois marche quand deux gran: The rule of three works when two quantities are proportional: if 3 kg cost €12, 5 kg cost 5 × 12 / 3 = €20.
Une hausse de t % multiplie par (1 + t/1: An increase of t% multiplies by (1 + t/100), a decrease by (1 − t/100). Successive changes chain by multiplying the coefficients.
+50 % puis −50 % ne ramène pas au départ: +50% then −50% does not bring you back to the start: 1.5 × 0.5 = 0.75, a 25% drop.
Point de pourcentage et pourcentage diff: Percentage points and percent differ: going from 10% to 12% is +2 points, but +20%.
Une baisse de 20 % ne se rattrape pas pa: A 20% drop is not made up by a 20% rise: you need +25%.
Hausse de 50 % puis baisse de 50 % : on: A 50% rise then a 50% drop: you end up at 75
Le hasard, l'indépendance, les paradoxes: Chance, independence, the paradoxes that fool intuition.
Probabilité = cas favorables ÷ cas possi: Probability = favorable cases ÷ possible cases, provided the cases are equally likely.
Deux événements indépendants : on multip: Two independent events: multiply their probabilities. Two heads in a row: 1/2 × 1/2 = 1/4.
Le hasard n'a pas de mémoire : après dix: Chance has no memory: after ten heads, the eleventh toss still has a one in two chance (the gambler's fallacy).
Monty Hall : changer de porte fait gagne: Monty Hall: switching doors wins 2 times out of 3, because the host knows where the car is and never opens that door.
Avec deux dés, 7 est la somme la plus pr: With two dice, 7 is the most likely sum (6 outcomes out of 36), not 12 (1 out of 36).
Tableau des 36 résultats possibles avec: Table of the 36 possible results with two dice
Implication, négation, syllogismes et ra: Implication, negation, syllogisms and proof by contradiction.
« Si A alors B » est faux dans un seul c: “If A then B” is false in only one case: A true and B false.
La contraposée « si non B alors non A »: The contrapositive “if not B then not A” is equivalent. The converse “if B then A” is not.
Nier « tous les cygnes sont blancs », c': Negating “all swans are white” means saying “at least one swan is not white”, not “no swan is white”.
Raisonnement par l'absurde : on suppose: Proof by contradiction: assume the opposite of what you want to prove and reach a contradiction.
Affirmer le conséquent : « s'il pleut, l: Affirming the consequent: “if it rains, the ground is wet; the ground is wet, so it's raining” is invalid.
Inconnues, équations, identités remarqua: Unknowns, equations, special products and systems.
Résoudre une équation : faire la même op: Solving an equation: do the same operation on both sides until the unknown is isolated.
Identités remarquables : (a + b)² = a² +: Special products: (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b², (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b², (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b².
(a + b)² n'est pas a² + b² : on oublie l: (a + b)² is not a² + b²: that forgets the cross term 2ab.
Un système de deux équations à deux inco: A system of two equations in two unknowns is solved by substitution or by elimination.
Diviser les deux côtés par x fait perdre: Dividing both sides by x loses the solution x = 0: factor instead.
Moyenne, médiane, écart type, corrélatio: Mean, median, standard deviation, correlation and samples.
La moyenne est sensible aux valeurs extr: The mean is sensitive to extreme values; the median splits the population into two halves and resists them.
Quand Bill Gates entre dans un bar, la m: When Bill Gates walks into a bar, the mean fortune explodes; the median barely moves.
L'écart type mesure la dispersion autour: The standard deviation measures the spread around the mean.
Corrélation n'est pas causalité : glaces: Correlation is not causation: ice cream and drownings rise together in summer, because of the heat.
Un salaire moyen supérieur au salaire mé: An average salary above the median salary doesn't mean most people earn more than the average: it's the opposite.
Cinq valeurs : médiane 2, moyenne 4 tiré: Five values: median 2, mean 4 pulled up by the value 12
Angles, aires, volumes, Pythagore, sinus: Angles, areas, volumes, Pythagoras, sine and cosine.
Pythagore : dans un triangle rectangle,: Pythagoras: in a right triangle, the square of the hypotenuse equals the sum of the squares of the other two sides (3, 4, 5).
Aire du disque π r², périmètre 2 π r ; v: Area of a disk π r², circumference 2 π r; volume of a sphere 4/3 π r³.
Doubler les longueurs multiplie les aire: Doubling lengths multiplies areas by 4 and volumes by 8.
Dans un triangle rectangle : sinus = opp: In a right triangle: sine = opposite / hypotenuse, cosine = adjacent / hypotenuse, tangent = opposite / adjacent.
La somme des angles d'un triangle vaut 1: The angles of a triangle add up to 180°, but only on a plane: on a sphere, they add up to more than 180°.
Agrandir une figure : longueurs, aires e: Enlarging a figure: lengths, areas and volumes
Suites, séries, limites et les paradoxes: Sequences, series, limits and the paradoxes of infinity.
Une suite géométrique de raison inférieu: A geometric sequence with ratio less than 1 in absolute value tends to 0; its sum can be finite: 1/2 + 1/4 + 1/8 + … = 1.
0,999… = 1 exactement : c'est la même so: 0.999… = 1 exactly: it's the same infinite sum written another way.
La série harmonique 1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + … di: The harmonic series 1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + … diverges, even though its terms tend to 0.
Cantor : il y a autant d'entiers pairs q: Cantor: there are as many even integers as integers, but strictly more real numbers than integers.
Que les termes tendent vers 0 ne suffit: Terms tending to 0 is not enough for an infinite sum to be finite.
Les sommes 1/2 + 1/4 + … s'approchent de: The sums 1/2 + 1/4 + … approach 1 without exceeding it
Espérance = somme de chaque gain × sa pr: Expected value = sum of each gain × its probability.
Second degré ax² + bx + c = 0 : discrimi: Quadratic ax² + bx + c = 0: discriminant Δ = b² − 4ac; if Δ > 0, two solutions (−b ± √Δ) ÷ 2a.
cos 60° = 1/2 : c'est la moitié d'un tri: cos 60° = 1/2: it is half of an equilateral triangle.
